_comment: The nine catalysts (CAT1). Every number is transcribed verbatim from docs/design/free-actions-and-catalysts.md §2.2 — the Designer owns any change to them. Three per phase; a character carries one of each. All are free actions (energyGain 0, no cooldown) consumed once per match, and all are built from effect kinds the engine already implements: this system needs no new EFFECT_KIND.

prep.name: Second Wind
prep.description: Heal 30. The emergency button: read their burst, survive it, and still act.

prep.name: Ablative Field
prep.description: Shield 35 for a turn. Pre-empt a predicted burst — bigger than any kit shield, but once.

prep.name: Brainwave
prep.description: Energized for 3 turns. Buy your ultimate about two turns early.

dash.name: Shift
dash.description: Blink up to 3 squares, through walls. Does not consume your Move.

dash.name: Fade
dash.description: Untargetable for a turn. Dodge without moving — keep your position and your attack.

dash.name: Unshackle
dash.description: Unstoppable for 2 turns. Walk out of Root and Slow, ignore knockback and pull.

blast.name: Adrenaline
blast.description: Might for 2 turns — and it boosts this turn's attack.

blast.name: Suppression
blast.description: Weaken every enemy within 2 for 2 turns. Blunt the counter-swing instead of raising your own.

blast.name: Overdrive
blast.description: Might 1 and Haste 1. The Might lands on this turn's Blast, the Haste on the Move after it.
